gates.boundary: Only runtime/** excluded; does not overwrite or replace original root lint failure.

classificationBoundaries: BUG002/003 are audit/test expectation fixes; no telemetry or official cloud feature is restored.
Recorded VM fixture and scheduler declaration/type-adoption failures remain in history; they are not new product bugs.
BUG004 only repairs first migration inputs; already committed empty 0005 is not replayed and no real-user data is restored.
Desktop raw failures, NOT_REACHED and pending are verification status, not automatic confirmation of additional product bugs.
